question: Will Ethereum (ETH) Reach $1932 by 10:20 P.M. (EDT) on July 21, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the ETH/USD spot price on Coinbase reached or exceeded $1,932.00 at any point on or before 02:20 UTC on July 22, 2026 (10:20 PM EDT on July 21, 2026), as reported by Coinbase.
- "No": Wins if the ETH/USD spot price on Coinbase did not reach or exceed $1,932.00 at any point on or before 02:20 UTC on July 22, 2026 (10:20 PM EDT on July 21, 2026), as reported by Coinbase.

Clarifications:
- "Reached" means the ETH/USD spot price traded at or above $1,932.00 at any moment up to and including 02:20 UTC on July 22, 2026; a price that touches $1,932.00 exactly satisfies the "Yes" condition.
- Price is measured in USD using the Coinbase ETH-USD spot pair; prices from other exchanges or trading pairs are not considered.
